core.interact: Move your cursor. Follow the signal.
core.static: A quiet view of the core
core.storyIntro: Follow a record through the quiet work between systems.
core.bridgeBody: The signal becomes a workspace. Review clean records, trace each import and follow delivery from one clear overview.
core.input.label: INPUT
core.input.title: Every source. One direction.
core.input.body: Scattered signals arrive at Astra Core. Keep the source intact while columns find their place.
core.input.note: CSV import is available today. API / JSON signals illustrate the architecture, not additional import connectors.
core.validation.label: VALIDATION
core.validation.title: Confidence starts with a check.
core.validation.body: A scan makes uncertainty visible. Emails, amounts and dates are checked; issues keep a field, a reason and a row.
core.deduplication.label: DEDUPLICATION
core.deduplication.title: Keep the signal. Once.
core.deduplication.body: Duplicate packets take a separate path. Normalized emails are compared with the source and existing records.
core.persistence.label: PERSISTENCE
core.persistence.title: A place for clean records.
core.persistence.body: Clean packets settle into structured storage. Records, the completion event and delivery jobs commit together.
core.event.label: EVENT / OUTBOX
core.event.title: Completion has a signal.
core.event.body: A completion signal enters the durable outbox. The worker carries the next step beyond the browser session.
core.event.note: A stable event ID · durable delivery jobs
core.delivery.label: DELIVERY
core.delivery.title: One signal. Connected systems.
core.delivery.body: The signal branches into Webhook and Telegram paths. Enabled integrations receive it through the worker, with retries and visible delivery history.
core.delivery.note: At-least-once delivery · receivers deduplicate event IDs
core.workspace.label: WORKSPACE
core.workspace.title: From flow to focus.
core.workspace.body: The abstract becomes practical. Your records, import history and quality signals come into view in the AstraSynq workspace.
core.workspace.note: Explore the workspace · sign in to your local account
core.input.brief: CSV records enter the core for processing.
core.validation.brief: Fields are checked; issues keep a reason and a row.
core.deduplication.brief: Duplicates are separated by normalized email.
core.persistence.brief: Clean records are committed to PostgreSQL.
core.event.brief: The completion signal is saved for reliable delivery.
core.delivery.brief: The worker delivers to Webhook / Telegram with retries.
core.workspace.brief: Review records, quality and import history.
core.bridge.recordsBody: Validated, normalized and ready to use.
core.bridge.importsBody: Sources, results and issues stay together.
core.bridge.eventsBody: Follow events through Webhook and Telegram.
core.bridge.access: Sign in to your local account to continue.
